contradicting_evidence: Prices, ETH/BTC and breadth improved versus the prior packet, while settled ETF outflows became smaller. These developments could precede a more durable repair if they persist.

The 90d observations still show positive BTC and median-alt returns, despite weaker recent performance and alt underperformance relative to BTC. The evidence does not establish an uninterrupted contraction regime.
Current ETH-relative resilience and reduced open interest leave room for relief advances without requiring immediate renewed leverage.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: An uneven downside-biased week is better supported than sustained broad expansion, with relief rallies possible along the way. This is not a forecast of uninterrupted decline: whether the current stabilization develops into recovery depends on new flow and participation evidence that is not yet available.
falsification_conditions: A persistent joint recovery in BTC and ETH, stronger ETH/BTC and broadening participation across the observed capitalization proxies would undermine the downside-biased path.
A sustained improvement in settled BTC and ETH flows together with stabilization or renewed expansion of stablecoin supply would remove important supports for this forecast.
missing_evidence: Additional settled sessions and repeated liquidity observations covering the forecast week.
A sustained ETH/BTC and breadth trajectory distinguishing broad recovery from isolated relative outperformance.
Verified prospective catalysts and contemporaneous macro changes capable of changing the weekly path.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply is contracting across daily, weekly and monthly windows, including approximately 1.88% over 7d and 3.64% over 30d. This is a liquidity headwind, not proof that contraction will continue.
Both BTC and ETH recorded material outflows in the latest settled ETF session; an improving institutional flow regime has not been demonstrated.

The 30d altseason observation is Bitcoin Season: only 12 of 49 constituents outperformed BTC, and the median alt return was approximately -21%. This weakens the case for an already established broad recovery.
Current large-, mid- and small-alt proxy medians are all negative. No observed capitalization segment demonstrates broad positive participation sufficient to confirm transmission.
